scripts.// prepare: core and claude-sdk export from dist/, which is gitignored — a clean checkout has no code behind those exports until something builds. npm 11 does NOT run a WORKSPACE package's prepare on a root install, so the hook has to live here; core keeps its own prepare/prepack for the publish path.
scripts.build: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w claude-sdk && npm run build -w claude-sdk-v2
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w core && npm run typecheck -w claude-sdk && npm run typecheck -w claude-sdk-v2 && npm run typecheck -w pi
scripts.test: npm test -w core && npm test -w claude-sdk && npm test -w claude-sdk-v2 && npm test -w pi
